meta.structure: Before 2004 (one bucket), then one entry per season from 2004-05

fields.date: As written on the sheet. Year inferred from the season where only a month was given
fields.status: read, not_read, cancelled or unclear; only set where the sheet has a tick, cross or note. Omitted otherwise
fields.format: film where the sheet marks the book [video]/movie
fields.author_gender: Female or Male, for the author. Where a book has several authors, the first named. Michael Lewis (editor) counts as male. Elena Ferrante is a pseudonym and is counted as female
fields.nationality: Citizenship or the country the author is most identified with. Several are judgement calls, see nationality_judgement_calls
fields.year_published: Year of first publication in the original language, not of the edition the club read
fields.original_language: Language the book was first written in
fields.category: Fiction or Non-fiction. Plays and short stories count as fiction; memoir and biography as non-fiction
fields.check: Present where the details above are uncertain and worth verifying

meta.author_note: Author and title spellings were corrected where the sheet was clearly off; the sheet's version is in note.
unresolved_notes_from_sheets: Red note on early list: do you remember if we did In the Skin of a Lion, Cinnamon Gardens, Saturday, Stones from the River, or The Book of Ruth?
